paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations. Row 1 (Baseline): Significant massive activations and attention sinks emerge after the 6th layer. Row 2 (SDPA Gating): Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed. Row 3 (Value Layer Gating): Similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid): Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата е линейна графика, която илюстрира промените в максималната стойност на активиране за различни компоненти на модела ( attn_output, ffn_output, attn_residual, ffn_residual ) през различни слоеве.

Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и има диапазон от 0 до 22, като етикетите са разположени на интервали от 5. Тя представлява слоевете на модела.

Оста Y е обозначена като "Max Activation Value" и има диапазон от 0 до 400. Тя показва максималната стойност на активиране и няма посочени единици.

Графиката съдържа четири линии, всяка от които представлява различен компонент на модела:
- attn_output е представен с плътна синя линия.
- ffn_output е представен с плътна зелена линия.
- attn_residual е представен с оранжева пунктирана линия.
- ffn_residual е представен с плътна червена линия.

В началото, около слой 0, всички линии започват близо до 0. 
- Линията attn_output започва близо до 0 и остава близо до 0 до около слой 20, след което се покачва рязко до около 100.
- Линията ffn_output също започва близо до 0 и се покачва леко до около 10 на слой 20, след което се покачва рязко до около 150.
- Линията attn_residual започва близо до 0 и се покачва бавно до около 50 на слой 20, след което се покачва рязко до около 250.
- Линията ffn_residual започва близо до 0, покачва се бавно до около 50 на слой 20 и след това рязко до около 375 на слой 22.

Около слой 20 има рязко покачване за всички линии, като най-рязко се покачват линиите attn_residual и ffn_residual.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The figure presents a line graph with the title "Massive Activation of atten_output_gate". The graph displays four lines, each representing a different variable: attn_output, ffn_output, attn_residual, and ffn_residual. 

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a range from 0 to 24, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5, but no units are specified. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and has a range from 0 to 400, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 50, but no units are specified. 

The attn_output line is blue, dashed, and has a relatively flat trend, starting at approximately 0 and ending at around 20. The ffn_output line is green, dotted, and also relatively flat, starting at approximately 0 and ending at around 10. The attn_residual line is orange, dotted, and increases gradually from around 5 to 250. The ffn_residual line is red, solid, and increases significantly from around 10 to 375.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four lines: attn_output (blue, dashed), ffn_output (green, dashed), attn_residual (orange, dotted), and ffn_residual (red, solid). The x-axis represents the layer, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, marked with tick labels at regular intervals of 5 units. The y-axis represents the maximum activation value, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, marked with tick labels at intervals of 50 units. The attn_output line starts near 0 and remains near 10 until around layer 20, then increases to around 120; the ffn_output line remains near 10 throughout. The attn_residual line starts below 5, remains near 10 until around layer 20, then increases to around 250. The ffn_residual line starts below 5, increases steadily to around 380.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Liniendiagramm zeigt einen Vergleich der maximalen Aktivierungswerte verschiedener Komponenten über die Schichten eines Sprachmodells. Die y-Achse ist mit "Max Activation Value" beschriftet, hat einen linearen Maßstab und einen Wertebereich von 0 bis 400, mit regelmäßigen Intervallen von 50 Einheiten. Die x-Achse ist mit "Layer" beschriftet und hat einen linearen Maßstab mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis etwa 23 Schichten. Vier Linien werden dargestellt: "attn_output" in Blau mit einer gestrichelten Linie und ohne Marker, "ffn_output" in Grün mit einer gestrichelten Linie und ohne Marker, "attn_residual" in Orange mit einer gepunkteten Linie und ohne Marker und "ffn_residual" in Rot mit einer durchgezogenen Linie und ohne Marker. Die Linie für "attn_output" beginnt bei etwa 2 und bleibt bis Schicht 20 relativ flach, bevor sie auf etwa 100 ansteigt. Die Linie für "ffn_output" beginnt bei etwa 1 und steigt leicht auf etwa 10 an, bevor sie auf etwa 80 ansteigt. Die Linie für "attn_residual" beginnt bei etwa 2 und steigt allmählich auf etwa 250 an. Die Linie für "ffn_residual" beginnt bei etwa 5 und steigt stark auf etwa 375 an.
